responsibility: This header defines the `thunderx2t99_tunings` model for Cavium ThunderX2 T99/Vulcan-class cores in the AArch64 backend. It contributes ThunderX2-specific address costs, register-move costs, AdvSIMD vector costs, prefetch settings, issue rate, fusion behavior, and related tuning parameters, giving GCC the per-core cost bundle used alongside the ThunderX2 scheduler model for tuning decisions.
same_name_distinction: This `thunderx2t99` file is the tuning-model header, not the machine-description scheduler: unlike `gcc/config/aarch64/thunderx2t99.md`, which models ThunderX2 pipeline resources and instruction latencies/reservations, it defines the `thunderx2t99_tunings` cost and heuristic data such as address, register-move, vector, prefetch, issue-rate, and fusion settings.
